Designed in collaboration with Leanne Kilroy of Good Bones

products.name: JENSEN Single Wall Light - Brass
products.description:
Add a touch of glamour to your home with the JENSEN Single Wall Spotlight in a luxurious brushed brass finish. This energy-efficient LED wall light is perfect for creating a warm and inviting ambiance in bedrooms, living rooms, and bathrooms. Featuring an adjustable axis and downward-facing spotlight, the JENSEN allows for targeted lighting, ideal for reading in bed, highlighting artwork in the living room, or creating a relaxing atmosphere in your bathroom.

The brushed brass finish offers a radiant, golden hue that adds a touch of sophistication and elegance to any décor. Its reflective surface beautifully captures and diffuses light, creating a warm and inviting glow.

This LED wall light is IP44 rated, ensuring safe use in bathrooms and other damp areas. Compact and stylish, the JENSEN measures 230 x 140 x 100 mm, making it a perfect fit for any space.

products.name: STELLA Swivel Wall Light - Cream Enamel & Antique Brass
products.description:
A softly curving swivel wall light that casts a subtle, patterned glow — for bedrooms, hallways and living rooms.
A soft cream enamel shade paired with warm antique brass detailing
A perforated shade scatters soft, patterned light while hiding the bulb, so you get glow without glare
The swivel arm adjusts left and right to aim the light — great as a bedside light, above a picture, or at a dressing table
Sits close to the wall with minimal projection
Takes an E27 bulb — we love a small G45 gold-capped bulb to diffuse the light, control glare and emphasise the patterns cast through the perforations; a standard bulb suits more practical lighting
Dimmable when paired with a dimmable bulb
Hardwired — we recommend a qualified electrician for installation
Designed in collaboration with Leanne Kilroy of Good Bones

Fully modular — combine dimmers and toggles across 1–4 gangs
Backed by a 5-year guarantee

Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.

productSections.heading: Materials & Care
productSections.html:
Finish
Unlacquered Brass
Base Material
Brass
Finishing Process
Polished
Material Characteristics
Unlacquered brass is a living finish. It responds to its surroundings and naturally develops a patina, meaning no two pieces will ever look exactly the same.
Product Care
Polished Finish:
Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.
Manufacturing Country
China

Product Care

Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.

productSections.heading: Materials & Care
productSections.html:
Finish
Unlacquered Brass
Base Material
Brass
Finishing Process
Polished
Material Characteristics
Unlacquered brass is a living finish. It responds to its surroundings and naturally develops a patina, meaning no two pieces will ever look exactly the same.
Product Care
Polished Finish:
Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.
Manufacturing Country
China

productSections.heading: Materials & Care
productSections.html:
Finish
Unlacquered Brass
Base Material
Brass
Finishing Process
Polished
Material Characteristics
Unlacquered brass is a living finish. It responds to its surroundings and naturally develops a patina, meaning no two pieces will ever look exactly the same.
Product Care
Polished Finish:
Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.
Manufacturing Country
China

productSections.html:
Finish
Polished Nickel
Base Material
Brass
Finishing Process
Polished
Material Characteristics
Material may age over time
Product Care
Polished Finish:
Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.
Manufacturing Country
China

productSections.heading: Materials & Care
productSections.html:
Finish
Unlacquered Brass
Base Material
Brass
Finishing Process
Polished
Material Characteristics
Unlacquered brass is a living finish. It responds to its surroundings and naturally develops a patina, meaning no two pieces will ever look exactly the same.
Product Care
Polished Finish:
Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.
Manufacturing Country
China

Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.

productSections.heading: Materials & Care
productSections.html:
Finish
Unlacquered Brass
Base Material
Brass
Finishing Process
Polished
Material Characteristics
Unlacquered brass is a living finish. It responds to its surroundings and naturally develops a patina, meaning no two pieces will ever look exactly the same.
Product Care
Polished Finish:
Clean regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap, then dry thoroughly. Apply a quality brass polish and finish with a thin coat of wax (such as Renaissance Wax) to preserve the shine and slow tarnishing. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning pads.
Natural Patina:
Wipe occasionally with a soft cloth and mild soap. The surface will gradually darken over time, developing unique tones and character that make each piece distinctly yours.
Manufacturing Country
China
